scope: Future character casting; existing chapter manifests remain historical records.
generation_settings: Use the model's saved defaults, record the resolved configuration and seed.
direction: Detailed vocal acoustics and speaking patterns, with screen-performance cues where established. Explicitly label original interpretations for unnamed or original characters and roles without a reliable speaking-voice target.
narrator: Keep Julian Vale and the existing narrator configuration unchanged.
remaining_current_cast: assets/supporting-cast.json contains two candidates for each of the other eleven speaking roles in Chapters 6 and 7.
reuse_workflow: Retain the selected original WAV and transcript. Validate Qwen Base full audio-and-transcript conditioning on unfamiliar dialogue before full chapter generation. Do not independently redesign a selected voice for each line.
existing_chapters: Do not regenerate or overwrite without a request. Legacy preset references in those chapters are not the preferred creation method for new casting.
off_page_characters: Design when speaking dialogue becomes available. Do not invent English dialogue for Chewbacca's narrated growls.
